chapters.title: I can introduce myself

lessons.title: Introduce yourself!
lessons.summary: The words you need to say who you are: your name, where you are from, what you do — and the greetings that come before all of them.
objectives: I can greet someone and say goodbye at the right time of day.
I can say my name, my country and my job.
I can ask someone the same three questions.

lessons.title: Making friends
lessons.summary: A first conversation with someone you have just met: how it opens, what you ask next, and how to keep it going when you have not understood.
objectives: I can start a conversation with someone I have just met.
I can ask a follow-up question and answer one about myself.
I can ask someone to repeat something or spell it.

lessons.title: Personal pronouns
lessons.summary: I, you, he, she, it, we, they — the words that replace a name, and the forms of 'to be' that go with each of them.
objectives: I can identify the subject pronoun that replaces a name or a thing.
I can use subject pronouns in short sentences with am, is and are.
I can tell the singular pronouns from the plural ones.

lessons.title: Hi! My name is Kim!
lessons.summary: A short self-introduction to read: who Kim is, where she lives and what she does — and the questions that check you have understood it.
objectives: I can understand a short written self-introduction.
I can find someone's name, country and job in a text.
I can write four sentences introducing myself.
